# Algarve Pain Centre

> Multidisciplinary pain, spine, sports and stroke clinic in Vale do Lobo, Almancil, Algarve, Portugal. English- and Portuguese-speaking team offering non-invasive, minimally invasive and, when indicated, surgical care in partnership.

Algarve Pain Centre treats chronic and acute pain with a stepped approach: conservative and non-invasive care first, image-guided minimally invasive procedures when appropriate, and surgery only when indicated, in partnership with its spine and orthopaedic surgeons. The clinic is the hub of several specialist centres (pain, spine, migraine, heart, knee & hip, primary care).

- Location: Av. do Mar, Vale do Lobo, 8135-107 Almancil, Algarve, Portugal
- Phone: +351 915 915 001
- Email: info@algarvepaincentre.com
- Languages: English, Portuguese
- Google rating: 4.9 stars (200+ reviews)
